business_overview.one_sentence: The group is a Hong Kong investment holding company operating motoring schools, treasury management / securities investment, and electronic toll related services through a joint venture.
business_overview.revenue_model: Course fees are recognised when driving lessons are completed; treasury management earns bank interest, investment dividends and fair value/disposal gains; electronic toll revenue includes consultancy/management fees and JV profit share.
business_notes: Treasury management is a formal reportable segment and holds most assets.
Motoring school customers typically prepay course fees, creating contract liabilities until lessons are completed.
The Tai Lam Tunnel ETC activity ceased in May 2025 after government takeover; HKeToll remains the main tolling platform.

gaps: The annual report does not split bank deposits/cash by parent, subsidiary and exact restriction status; analysis applies Hong Kong/offshore group-level haircut rather than treating all cash as freely distributable.
The report does not disclose maturity/lock-up terms for each unlisted fund; Level 3 fund assets are therefore given a low detachable haircut.
Maintenance versus growth capex is not separately disclosed; purchase of property, plant and equipment is used as a conservative capex proxy.
